steps.label: Clip ear on peg
steps.instruction: Line that loose ear's hole up with its little peg, then press with firm thumb pressure until it pops on.
steps.pass_condition: they say the loose ear popped onto its peg and both ears look clipped on

attempts.seen: They answered I believe so when asked if both flapper ears are clipped on, and the now photo with a hand on the red flapper does not plainly show an ear off.

steps.label: Flush to test
steps.instruction: Flush the toilet and watch the flapper drop and the tank refill.
steps.pass_condition: the flapper drops flat and sealed, the tank refills and they say the leaking has stopped

attempts.seen: They only said yes to the ears being clipped and neither photo shows a flush happening.
attempts.correction: Did you flush it yet? Go ahead and flush and tell me if the red flapper drops flat and the leaking stops.

attempts.seen: They said the leaking stopped and the second photo shows the red flapper sitting flat and sealed.
